    [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] →

        (Fin n → Bool) → (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ → H →L[ℂ] H) → Submodule ℂ H → Prop :=
fun {n} {H} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] ε σ S => ∀ g ∈ OriginalRe3.d21 ε, ∀ v ∈ S, (σ g) v ∈ S

def OriginalRe3.IsWtOn.{u_1} : {n : ℕ} →
  {H : Type u_1} →
    [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] →
      [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] →
        Set (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) → (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ → H →L[ℂ] H) → (Fin n → ℝ) → H → Prop :=
fun {n} {H} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] G σ μ v =>
  ∀ (θ : Fin n → ℝ),
    (Matrix.diagonal fun a => Complex.exp (↑(θ a) * Complex.I)) ∈ G →
      (σ (Matrix.diagonal fun a => Complex.exp (↑(θ a) * Complex.I))) v =
        Complex.exp (↑(∑ a, μ a * θ a) * Complex.I) • v

  {H : Type u_1} →
    [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] →
      [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] →
        (Fin n → Bool) → (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ → H →L[ℂ] H) → (Fin n → ℝ) → Submodule ℂ H → Prop :=
fun {n} {H} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] ε σ Λ S =>
  FiniteDimensional ℂ ↥S ∧
    OriginalRe3.IsKStableOn ε σ S ∧
